open_kakariko.open: The gate is open from the start and the castle visit is skipped. Zelda's Letter and the Song from Impa, or whatever is placed there, are given when a new game starts.

open_door_of_time._: Start with the Door of Time already open, so the Ocarina and the Song of Time are not needed to reach the Master Sword. The Door of Time quest is left alone, so Zelda's escape and the Song of Time stay checks. The adult pedestal works before the Forest Sage in every seed, with or without this setting.

shuffle_pots._: Which pots, including flying pots, hold random items. Key items whose pickup pack is built can sit in a pot. A pot that holds a key item is saved as broken only when its item is picked up, so if the item falls into a pit, lands out of reach or is left behind, the pot is back with it the next time the area loads. Rupees, hearts and ammo from a pot are given once and are gone if they are not picked up. Flying pots work the same way.

A crate that holds a key item is saved as broken only when its item is picked up, so it is back with the item the next time the area loads if the item is left behind. shuffle_freestanding_items._: Which items lying on the ground hold random items. Rupees, hearts, heart pieces, the two shields, the other world pickups the game ships except the Gold Skulltula Token and Fire Arrows, and every key item whose pickup pack is built can be placed there. A spot that exists once per age only takes items that do no harm when found twice, such as rupees, hearts, ammo and gear that a second copy does not change.

Upgrades are ticked by tier and the highest ticked tier counts: Longshot means two progressive Hookshots, Big Quiver means the Bow and one quiver upgrade, Big Bullet Bag means the Slingshot and one bullet bag upgrade, Giant's Wallet means two wallet upgrades, Double Magic means two magic upgrades, Ocarina of Time means both ocarinas, Golden Gauntlets means all three strength upgrades. Bags start full. Bombchus need a bomb bag. Zelda's Letter cannot be given.

starting_songs._: Songs you already know when the game starts. Each one is taken out of the item pool when its lesson is shuffled. Playing them still needs an Ocarina.

shuffle_rewards.off: These rewards keep their original items.
shuffle_rewards.supported: The rewards whose event the tool can edit.
shuffle_rewards._: Whether the items that NPCs, minigames, Great Fairies and story scenes hand out are shuffled. This is on by default. The Spiritual Stones and Medallions from the bosses and Rauru stay in place unless Stones and Medallions is also on. Songs have their own setting.

shuffle_boss_hearts._: Whether the Heart Containers that bosses leave behind join the item pool. Each one becomes a chest that holds a random item.

shuffle_songs.off: Every song comes from its usual teacher.
shuffle_songs.own: The songs are shuffled among the places that teach songs.
shuffle_songs.anywhere: Songs can appear anywhere, also in pots, crates, freestanding spots and at Gold Skulltulas when those are shuffled, and song locations can hold any item.
shuffle_songs._: Whether the songs you learn from NPCs and Sheik are shuffled. The lessons still play the usual melody scene. A song found anywhere else is handed out like an item with its get window and shows Sheik's harp. Scarecrow's Song is never shuffled. Experimental, untested in the game.

gossip_hints._: Every gossip stone tells you where an important item lies. The stones need no Mask of Truth text change, only the words are replaced.

faster_chests._: Shortens the waiting time in chest openings and item pickup scenes, and big chests open with the short small chest animation instead of the long big chest cutscene, like the OoTR option Fast Chest Cutscenes. The text, the item and the dungeon map, compass and boss key credit are the same.

start_reward.off: You start with no stones or medallions.
start_reward._: Begin the game already holding one random Spiritual Stone or Medallion. The vanilla copy still exists.

skip_intro._: A new game skips the opening movie and the wake up scene in Link's house, and you get control right away.

chests_match_contents._: Chests holding major items, the items that can unlock progress, and boss keys become big chests, and chests holding anything else (rupees, ammo, hearts, maps, compasses and small keys) become small chests, like the OoTR option Chest Appearance Matches Contents. Only the plain wooden chests change; chests that run a story scene, invisible chests and the minigame chests keep their size. A big chest is wider than a small one, so a chest that grows may stand closer to a wall. Experimental, untested in the game.

shuffle_potion_shop._: The free empty bottle the Market Potion Shop keeper gives a child after the meeting with Zelda and the Red Potion he pours as thanks for the escaped bug become two shuffled checks, and one more Bottle joins the pool. While the free bottle holds another item he starts the bug tutorial only for a child who already carries an empty bottle, and his shelves still open after the tutorial.

shuffle_rewards_extra._: Also shuffle the rewards that need bigger event edits: the 20 token Skulltula reward, Biggoron and Medigoron.

shuffle_skulltulas.pinned: Only the skulltulas whose remake actor is known for sure are shuffled.
shuffle_skulltulas.matched: Also the pools of skulltulas that share the same logic, and the skulltulas that our hash research pairs with their spot. The skulltulas whose spot is still unsure only drop minor items such as rupees and hearts.
shuffle_skulltulas._: Whether Gold Skulltulas drop random items and their tokens join the item pool. A skulltula can drop items that the game has a pickup for and key items whose pickup pack is built, as a kit pickup that plays the get window. A killed skulltula stays gone only once its dropped item is picked up, and it comes back if the item is left behind.

shuffle_trade_checks._: Each of the ten adult trade quest hand ins also gives one shuffled item the first time. The trade items themselves stay in their vanilla order.

shuffle_scrubs_a._: Also shuffle the Business Scrubs that already sell one item once: the Death Mountain Crater heart scrub and the Lost Woods stick and nut bag scrubs. The price stays and the sale text still names the old item.

shuffle_remake_chests.off: These chests keep their original items.
shuffle_remake_chests._: Whether the chests that only the remake has, and the dungeon and overworld chests newly paired with their OoTR spot, join the item pool. Their rules come from research. Seven overworld chests whose spot is unproven only take items that are not progression.

shuffle_scrubs_b._: Also shuffle the Business Scrubs in the Lost Woods scrub grotto and in Jabu Jabu's Belly. A scrub that holds another item sells it once for 20 or 30 rupees instead of its menu, and its sale text still names a heart piece.

bombchus_in_logic._: Experimental. Bombchus count as explosives in the seed logic, so walls, switches and enemies that need an explosive can be handled with Bombchus and no Bomb Bag. This follows the OoTR option that considers Bombchus in logic. Only the logic side is done here, the remake gets no separate Bombchu bag and no Bombchu drops. Caution: in our test of the remake, Bombchus only worked once a Bomb Bag and its ammo maximum were set, and a Bombchu pickup gave a count of 0 without them. The game is also reported to gate Bombchu use on a bag or a defeated Dodongo. A seed with this ticked may expect Bombchus where the game will not let you use them.

shuffle_shops.off: Every shop sells its usual goods.
shuffle_shops.shuffle: The usual shop goods move between the shops and keep their prices, nothing new is sold.
shuffle_shops.deals_1: One slot in each shop sells a random item once, the other slots sell shuffled shop goods.
shuffle_shops.deals_2: Two slots in each shop sell a random item once, the other slots sell shuffled shop goods.
shuffle_shops.deals_3: Three slots in each shop sell a random item once, the other slots sell shuffled shop goods.
shuffle_shops.deals_4: Four slots in each shop sell a random item once, the other slots sell shuffled shop goods.
shuffle_shops.random: Each shop gets 0 to 4 special deals, the Kokiri Shop at least one.
shuffle_shops._: Whether the shelves of the eight shelf shops sell shuffled goods or random items. The Happy Mask Shop stays as it is. Prices above 200 rupees need a bigger wallet in the logic. Experimental, none of these edits are tested in the game yet except one Kokiri Shop deal.

shop_prices.vanilla: A deal costs what its slot cost before.
shop_prices.weighted: Prices between the lowest and the highest price, leaning to the middle.
shop_prices.uniform: Every price between the lowest and the highest price is equally likely.
shop_prices._: How the price of a special deal is chosen. Shop goods always keep their own price.

shop_price_max._: The highest price a special deal can have, in steps of 5 rupees. Above 200 the logic asks for the Adult's Wallet, above 500 for the Giant's Wallet. Kokiri Shop deals never cost more than 200, so the Kokiri Sword and other early items stay in reach.

shop_price_min._: The lowest price a special deal can have, in steps of 5 rupees.

shop_deal_items._: Special deals always take items that cannot be held twice. These classes can be added. Ammo, refills and hearts only go to the shops with one keeper (the two Bazaars and the Bombchu Shop), since only there one purchase closes the slot for good. Experimental, untested in the game.

shop_deal_gear._: Lets the Bow, the Slingshot, the Bomb Bag and the Magic Meter stand on special deals. The shelf shows the first item of the family. After the purchase the shop flow adds what the chest or the Great Fairy would add, the small quiver and 30 arrows, the small bullet bag and 30 seeds, 20 bombs, or the double magic bar, then the top tier of the family, as for every upgrade on a shelf. A player who already owns the first item is told the bag is full, as for any deal. Experimental, untested in the game.

shuffle_cows._: The cow in Link's House and the cow in Gerudo Valley each give one extra shuffled item the first time their milk scene starts, with or without a bottle. The milk stays vanilla and stays repeatable. The other cows have their own setting.

shuffle_cows_other._: The six other cows each give one extra shuffled item the first time their milk scene starts, with or without a bottle: the Gerudo Fortress cow, the Death Mountain Trail and Hyrule Field grotto cows, the cow behind Impa's house and the two Lon Lon Ranch stable cows. The five ordinary cows become actor classes of their own. The milk stays vanilla and stays repeatable. Experimental, untested in the game.

shuffle_beehives._: Whether the seven beehives in the covered hole of Kakariko Village hold random items. They are the only beehives in the remake that drop an item. Key items whose pickup pack is built can sit in a hive. A hive that holds a key item is saved as fallen only when its item is picked up, so it is back with the item the next time the area loads if the item is left behind. Rupees, hearts and ammo are given once. A hive needs an explosive to open the hole and then the Boomerang, the Hookshot or a bow to bring down. Experimental, untested in the game.

skip_cutscenes.story: The opening movie and the first credits movie can be skipped. The six title screen demos stay locked.
skip_cutscenes.all: Also unlocks the six title screen demos. Pressing the skip button on the title screen may then skip a demo.
skip_cutscenes._: Removes the lock that stops the player from skipping some cutscenes. Most cutscenes can already be skipped by holding the skip button, only eight are locked.

anju_one_cucco._: Anju in Kakariko Village counts the cucco game as won when one cucco is in the pen instead of seven. The Bottle reward is the same. The logic needs one cucco too.

big_poe_one._: The Ghost Shop owner in the Market gives the Bottle for the first big poe, where the game wants five. The golden reward after ten big poes is unchanged. The logic needs one big poe.

shuffle_treasure_reward._: Whether the final reward of the Market Treasure Chest Game, a Piece of Heart, holds a random item. Only the first win gives it, later wins give the usual red rupee. The five rooms keep their keys and rupees. Only unique items that do nothing when found twice can be placed there, so no upgrades, ammo, bottles or keys.

shuffle_dungeon_rewards._: Also shuffle the three Spiritual Stones and six Medallions that the bosses and Rauru hand out. When this is off, every boss and Rauru give their usual Stone or Medallion, and no Stone or Medallion turns up anywhere else.

jabu_open._: Jabu Jabu opens his mouth without a fish, so no fish and no bottle are needed to enter Jabu Jabu's Belly. King Zora still has to be moved first unless Zora's Fountain is open.

time_always_passes._: The day and night clock runs from the start instead of waiting for Kaepora in Hyrule Field and Impa's send off, so night can be reached before meeting Zelda.

early_beds._: Beds offer Sleep until morning and Sleep until night before the Zelda meeting.

navi_return.off: Navi stays quiet when she has no hint.
navi_return.dungeons: Inside a dungeon or its boss room, Navi offers a trip back to the dungeon entrance.
navi_return.everywhere: Also outside dungeons: back to Kokiri Forest as a child, or the Temple of Time as an adult.
navi_return._: Calling Navi with the D-pad asks whether to head back, like the original game restarting a saved file at the dungeon entrance, in Kokiri Forest or in the Temple of Time. Needs no item. The D-pad calls Navi from the start of a new game, and her room tutorial hints are replaced by the question; enemy hints while targeting stay. Boss rush, final battle and miniboss arena maps never offer it. Experimental, untested in the game.

bunny_hood.off: The Bunny Hood is only a mask, as in the original game.
bunny_hood.speed: Link runs 1.5 times as fast while wearing the Bunny Hood.
bunny_hood.jump: Link also leaves the ground 1.5 times as fast when jumping, so jumps go further.
bunny_hood._: Gives the Bunny Hood the speed boost it has in Majora's Mask, like the OoTR option of the same name. Works for child and adult Link. Done in the player's AI graphs, with no code patch: while the hood is worn, Link's forward speed is multiplied by 1.5 each frame, up to a cap that is higher for adult Link. Experimental.

misc_hints._: Characters who know something tell you, in their own words, like the OoTR option of the same name. Altar: the Temple of Time altar says where each medallion rests. Dampé's diary: says where a Progressive Hookshot is. House of Skulltula: the cursed rich man names each token reward. Frogs: the Zora's River frogs name the prize of their ocarina game and of the rainy song. Great Fairies: each fairy names what she grants next to her price. Sheik: while waiting in the Temple of Time, Sheik says where the Light Arrows are. Malon: says where the Weird Egg went, only while the Kakariko gate starts closed. Mido: lets slip where the Kokiri Sword is. Saria: when you meet her in the Sacred Forest Meadow, she says where the Magic Meter is. Only the words change, in every language, with the hint itself in English. Experimental, untested in the game.

skip_epona_race._: Learning Epona's Song counts as having won Epona from Ingo: the game's "Epona is Link's horse" flag is rewritten to read whether the song has been learned, so the ranch race against Ingo is skipped and an adult with the song can call Epona. The Epona quest step is left alone, so child Malon's song lesson still works. Experimental, untested in the game.

skip_mask_quest._: The Happy Mask Shop quest starts complete, like the OoTR option Complete Mask Quest: once the shop opens with Zelda's Letter, every mask can be borrowed right away, including the Mask of Truth, without selling the Keaton, Skull, Spooky and Bunny masks first. Selling masks for rupees goes away, which costs no check. Experimental, untested in the game.

plant_beans._: Every magic bean patch starts planted, like the OoTR option Plant Magic Beans, so the adult bean platforms are there from the start. The Magic Bean leaves the item pool, and the bean salesman in Zora's River has one sale left, for 60 rupees, holding a random item when NPC rewards are shuffled. Experimental, untested in the game.

gerudo_bridge_open._: Opens the way to Gerudo Fortress: the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley is repaired from the start, so adult Link can cross without Epona or the Longshot. The carpenters in the Thieves' Hideout are not rescued, so the guards, the rescue and the Gerudo Membership Card stay as they are. Experimental, untested in the game.

shuffle_entrances.off: Every entrance leads where it always does.
shuffle_entrances.dungeons: The eleven dungeon doors lead to other dungeons: Deku Tree, Dodongo's Cavern, Jabu Jabu's Belly, Bottom of the Well, Ice Cavern, Gerudo Training Ground and the Forest, Fire, Water, Shadow and Spirit Temples. Ganon's Castle, boss rooms, blue warps and warp songs stay. Experimental, untested in the game.
shuffle_entrances.overworld: The area to area transitions of the overworld lead to other areas. Not built yet, a seed with this is refused.
shuffle_entrances.everything: Dungeons, overworld transitions and later interiors and grottos, each kept in its own pool. Not built yet, a seed with this is refused.
shuffle_entrances._: Which doors and transitions lead somewhere else. Entrances are coupled, so the way back always returns you to the door you came in by. Experimental, untested in the game. Only Off and Dungeons work in this build.

shuffle_rocks.off: These checks keep their original items.
shuffle_rocks.overworld: Only checks outside dungeons are shuffled.
shuffle_rocks.dungeons: Only checks inside dungeons are shuffled.
shuffle_rocks.all: Every check of this kind is shuffled.
shuffle_rocks._: Which small liftable rocks hold random items. The adult and the child copy of a rock are separate checks. Key items whose pickup pack is built can sit under a rock. A rock that holds a key item is saved as broken only when its item is picked up, so if a thrown rock drops it out of reach it is back with the item the next time the area loads. Rupees, hearts and ammo are given once. Experimental, untested in the game.

shuffle_grass.off: These checks keep their original items.
shuffle_grass.overworld: Only checks outside dungeons are shuffled.
shuffle_grass.dungeons: Only checks inside dungeons are shuffled.
shuffle_grass.all: Every check of this kind is shuffled.
shuffle_grass._: Which grass tufts hold random items, in the overworld and in the Deku Tree and the Bottom of the Well. Key items whose pickup pack is built can sit in grass. A tuft that holds a key item is saved as cut only when its item is picked up, so it is back with the item the next time the area loads if the item is left behind. Rupees, hearts and ammo are given once. The bug grass of the Lost Woods is left alone. Experimental, untested in the game.

shuffle_silver_rupees._: The silver rupees of five rooms become items: the Forest and Light Trials in Ganon's Castle, the Ice Cavern push block room, the Bottom of the Well basement and the Gerudo Training Ground slopes room. Each room has five Silver Rupee items that are found in chests anywhere, and the room opens when you have found all five. The spots where the silver rupees hung hold other rupees. Needs Remake chests on, because the other chests are already full. Experimental, untested in the game.

shuffle_remake_pots.off: These checks keep their original items.
shuffle_remake_pots.overworld: Only checks outside dungeons are shuffled.
shuffle_remake_pots.dungeons: Only checks inside dungeons are shuffled.
shuffle_remake_pots.all: Every check of this kind is shuffled.
shuffle_remake_pots._: Which of the 213 pots, crates and flying pots that only the remake has, with no spot of the original game matched to them, hold random items. They sit in every dungeon but the Deku Tree and the Gerudo Training Ground, and in Kakariko, the Market, the hideout, the fortress, Lon Lon Ranch, Zora's River and Fountain and more. Their logic region comes from the room data and the nearest known checks, the harder one where two fit, so a few may be logically placed too early. They hold the same items as the other pots and crates, key items included. Experimental, untested in the game.

shuffle_frog_songs._: The frogs in Zora's River give one shuffled item the first time you play each of Zelda's Lullaby, Epona's Song, Saria's Song, the Sun's Song and the Song of Time to them, in place of the rupees. The Song of Storms Heart Piece is a check of its own as before.

shuffle_frog_bug_heart._: The first win of the frog bug game in Zora's River, which opens after all six frog songs, gives a shuffled item in place of the Heart Piece. Later wins still give a Blue Rupee.

deku_bridge_safe._: The wooden bridge in the Deku Tree slingshot room stays up when Link walks, rolls or jumps on it, so you never drop into the pit below it. Nothing else in the dungeon changes and the logic is the same, because the room never needed the bridge to break. Without the Slingshot the jump across has a window of about nine frames, so this keeps the room fair when the chests there hold other items. A bridge that already broke in a save stays broken. Experimental, untested in the game.
